records.source: Permission denied. These files were kept.
records.translation: Aðgangi hafnað. Þessar skrár voru varðveittar.

records.source: The uninstall selection changed. Review the paths again.
records.translation: Valið fyrir fjarlægingu hefur breyst. Farðu aftur yfir slóðirnar.
